IGUI_TREK_Recalled: The shuttle lifts and is gone
IGUI_TREK_TakingOff: The shuttle lifts above the trees
IGUI_TREK_FlightControls: W A S D: fly   |   Right-click: land, enter, or beam down

IGUI_TREK_NoReturnPoint: There is nowhere recorded to beam back to
IGUI_TREK_NoBeamSite: No clear ground to materialise on down there

IGUI_TREK_HelmPrompt: Click the map to set a course, or pick a logged position below. The whole map is shown while the helm is open. Taking her down beams you to the site first -- the shuttle needs %1 clear squares to sit on, and if it cannot find them you are beamed straight back aboard.
IGUI_TREK_NoCourse: Set a course on the map first.
IGUI_TREK_ArrivalFailed: The cabin would not hold; you have been put back outside
